Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 114: October 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #114 shipped to subscribers in September 2010 (bearing the cover date of October 2010 for Issue 114). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #114 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (third-person action-adventure)
Apache: Air Assault (combat flight simulator)
CSI: Fatal Conspiracy (mystery graphic adventure)
Costume Quest (Xbox Live Arcade RPG adventure)
Pac-Man Championship Edition DX (Xbox Live Arcade maze action)
Pinball FX 2 (Xbox Live Arcade virtual pinball simulation)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for Call of Duty: Black Ops, Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit, and Dragon Age II, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
